mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_records (user_id, eat_date, eat_time, meal_type, memo, diet_img_url, total_calories, total_carbohydrate, total_protein, total_fat, total_sugars, total_sodium, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eatDate}, #{eatTime}, #{mealType}, #{memo}, #{dietImgUrl}, #{totalCalories}, #{totalCarbohydrate}, #{totalProtein}, #{totalFat}, #{totalSugars}, #{totalSodium}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, dd.diet_detail_id, dd.food_id, dd.food_name, dd.quantity, dd.unit, dd.calories AS d_calories, dd.carbohydrate AS d_carbohydrate, dd.protein AS d_protein, dd.fat AS d_fat, dd.sugars AS d_sugars, dd.sodium AS d_sodium FROM diet_records d LEFT JOIN diet_details dd ON d.diet_id = dd.diet_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.eat_date = #{eatDate} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.eat_time ASC

SELECT d.*, dd.diet_detail_id, dd.food_id, dd.food_name, dd.quantity, dd.unit, dd.calories AS d_calories, dd.carbohydrate AS d_carbohydrate, dd.protein AS d_protein, dd.fat AS d_fat, dd.sugars AS d_sugars, dd.sodium AS d_sodium FROM diet_records d LEFT JOIN diet_details dd ON d.diet_id = dd.diet_id WHERE d.diet_id = #{dietId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_records SET eat_time = #{eatTime}, meal_type = #{mealType}, memo = #{memo}, diet_img_url = #{dietImgUrl}, total_calories = #{totalCalories}, total_carbohydrate = #{totalCarbohydrate}, total_protein = #{totalProtein}, total_fat = #{totalFat}, total_sugars = #{totalSugars}, total_sodium = #{totalSodium}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE diet_id = #{dietId}
mapper.select:
SELECT eat_date AS date,
-- 스키마의 실제 컬럼명(total_*)으로 변경 및 DTO 필드명(G, Mg)으로 별칭 부여 COALESCE(SUM(total_calories), 0) AS totalCalories, COALESCE(SUM(total_carbohydrate), 0) AS carbsG, COALESCE(SUM(total_protein), 0) AS proteinG, COALESCE(SUM(total_fat), 0) AS fatG, COALESCE(SUM(total_sugars), 0) AS sugarG, COALESCE(SUM(total_sodium), 0) AS sodiumMg
FROM diet_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND eat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY eat_date ORDER BY eat_date ASC
